dealer_hello_first.text: Well well, a fresh face. (confident) Looking for hardware? I got what you need.

dealer_hello_2.text: What can I get you this time?

dealer_buy_2.text: (laughing) Hey, don't point it at me.

dealer_nocash_1.text: Come back when you got the cash.

dealer_nocash_2.text: (sighing) No money, no hardware. Simple as that.

clerk_hello_1.text: (happy) Welcome to RaceTrac. Let me know if you need anything.

clerk_scared.text: (scared) P-please don't try anything, man. I just work here.

clerk_rob_1.text: (scared) Okay okay! Take it! Take the money, man!

clerk_rob_2.text: (scared) Don't shoot! The register's open, just go!

cop_fire_1.text: (shouting) He's got a gun! Open fire!

cop_fire_2.text: (shouting) Take him down! Take him down!

cop_down.text: Suspect down. Somebody clean up this mess.

pedf_gun.text: (scared) Oh my god, he's got a gun!

pedo_hit.text: (angry) Hooligans! In my day we had manners!

cop_fire_f_1.text: (shouting) He's got a gun! Open fire!

cop_fire_f_2.text: (shouting) Take him down! Take him down!

xander_1.text: (happy) Oh hey, what's up? I paused my game for this.

xander_2.text: Man, I could totally be gaming right now.

xander_3.text: Sup. You tryna co-op or what?

xander_4.text: (laughing) Bro, that was straight up a headshot.

xander_5.text: (sighing) Aw, come on, I was so close.

xander_6.text: GG, man. I gotta get back to my save.

xander_7.text: (scared) Whoa whoa, this ain't a game anymore!

xander_8.text: Alright, catch you later. Add me online.

atc_runway_1.text: (confused) Unknown aircraft, you are not cleared for takeoff. Vacate the runway immediately.

atc_runway_2.text: (annoyed) Hold your position! You are not authorized. Get off the active runway, now!

atc_hijack_1.text: (shouting) All units — aircraft departing without clearance! Possible hijack in progress!

atc_hijack_2.text: (nervous) Unauthorized departure — we have a possible hijacking. Notify the authorities!

frat_intro_1.text: You wanna run it, little bro? I mog you in every single way.

frat_intro_2.text: Welcome to the chapter house. I am the president, and you are about to get absolutely mogged.

frat_taunt_1.text: Look at my hunter eyes! You are sub-five P S L, it is so over for you.

frat_taunt_2.text: I mew twelve hours a day, bro. Your jaw does not even exist.

frat_taunt_3.text: It is called frame, little bro, and you will never have it.

frat_summon_1.text: Pledges! Handle this G D I!

frat_hurt_1.text: Not the face, bro, that is my moneymaker!

frat_phase_1.text: No... this cannot be... my frame...

frat_phase_2.text: You think that is it? I have got... peptides.

frat_phase_3.text: Time to frame mog even harder!

frat_enrage_1.text: Now I am dimorphic, little bro!

frat_enrage_2.text: This is your looksmaxxing final boss!

frat_death_2.text: Tell the brothers... I maxxed out...

fratboy_2.text: It is a frat thing, you would not get it!
